name: @tencent-rtc/trtc-agent-skills
description: Installer for the TRTC Agent Skills suite (Chat, Call, RTC Engine, Live, Conference) plus manual SDK runtime log troubleshooting and knowledge base, with one-command MCP setup for Claude Code / Cursor / CodeBuddy / Codex.

scripts.test: npm run test:reporting-release && npm run test:chat-ios && npm run test:sdk-log
scripts.test:reporting: node --test scripts/test-codex-attribution-permissions.test.js scripts/cli.test.js scripts/cli-reporting-install.test.js scripts/cli-c19-mode.test.js scripts/cli-c19-migration.test.js scripts/cli-runtime-binding.test.js scripts/test-reporting-python.test.js && node scripts/test-reporting-python.js
scripts.test:reporting-release: npm run check:telemetry-bundle && npm --prefix tests/reporting-v2 run test:all && npm run test:reporting && npm run test:cli-copy-filter && npm run test:telemetry-bundle && npm run test:telemetry-node16 && npm run test:reporting-v2-hook-performance && npm run test:reporting-package && npm run test:reporting-c14-local && npm run test:strict-privacy
scripts.test:chat-ios: python3 -B skills/trtc-chat-ios/scripts/validate_skill.py --acceptance-file tests/trtc-chat-ios/acceptance.json && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/trtc-chat-ios -p "test_*.py"
